items.source: ApplicationContextException - in case of initialization errors
items.translation: ApplicationContextException - 在初始化错误的情况下

items.source: BeansException - if thrown by ApplicationContext methods
items.translation: BeansException - 如果由 ApplicationContext 方法抛出

items.source: IllegalStateException - if not running in an ApplicationContext
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未在 ApplicationContext 中运行

items.source: The default implementation calls the overloaded initApplicationContext() method without ApplicationContext reference.
items.translation: 默认实现调用不带 ApplicationContext 引用的重载initApplicationContext()方法。

items.source: The default implementation is empty. Called by initApplicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 默认实现为空。由 initApplicationContext(ApplicationContext) 调用。

items.source: Note: Does not get called on re-initialization of the context but rather just on first initialization of this object's context reference.
items.translation: 注意：`not` 不会在上下文重新初始化时被调用，而仅在该对象的上下文引用首次初始化时调用。

items.source:
There is no requirement to subclass this class: It just makes things
a little easier if you need access to the context, for example, for access to
file resources or to the message source. Note that many application
objects do not need to be aware of the application context at all,
as they can receive collaborating beans via bean references.
items.translation: 无需继承此类：仅在需要访问上下文（例如，用于访问文件资源或消息源）时，这样做会稍微方便一些。请注意，许多应用程序对象根本不需要感知应用程序上下文，因为它们可以通过 Bean 引用接收协作 Bean。

items.source:
Many framework classes are derived from this class, particularly
within the web support.
items.translation: 许多框架类都派生自该类，特别是在 Web 支持中。

items.source:
Default is "false". Can be overridden to enforce running in a context
(i.e. to throw IllegalStateException on accessors if outside a context).
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。可以将其覆盖以强制在上下文中运行（即，如果在上下文之外访问器则抛出 IllegalStateException）。

items.source: Determine the context class that any context passed to setApplicationContext must be an instance of. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 确定传递给 `setApplicationContext` 的上下文必须是哪个上下文的实例。可在子类中重写。

items.source: Logger that is available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Return the ApplicationContext that this object is associated with.
items.translation: 返回该对象关联的 ApplicationContext。

items.source:
Return a MessageSourceAccessor for the application context
used by this object, for easy message access.
items.translation: 返回此对象使用的应用程序上下文中的 MessageSourceAccessor，以便轻松访问消息。

items.source: Subclasses can override this for custom initialization behavior.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以实现自定义初始化行为。

items.source: Obtain the ApplicationContext for actual use.
items.translation: 获取实际使用的 ApplicationContext。

items.source: BeansException - if thrown by application context methods
items.translation: BeansException - 如果由应用程序上下文方法抛出

items.source: IllegalStateException - in case of no ApplicationContext set
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未设置 ApplicationContext

items.source: context - the ApplicationContext object to be used by this object
items.translation: context - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象

items.source: context - the containing ApplicationContext
items.translation: context - 包含的 ApplicationContext

items.source: the ApplicationContext (never null)
items.translation: ApplicationContext（永远不为null）

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method. Invoked after ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader), ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) and MessageSourceAware, if applicable.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware

items.translation: 确定传递给 setApplicationContext 的任何上下文必须是哪个上下文的实例。

items.source: Determine whether this application object needs to run in an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 确定此应用程序对象是否需要在 ApplicationContext 中运行。

items.source: Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in.
items.translation: 设置此对象运行的 ApplicationContext。
